1.1 EXT. ROOFTOP – DAY1 1

Wind whips across the rooftop. EDMUND stands at the edge, eyes filled with despair. ROSE (22) rushes in, panting. ROSEEdmund! Get down!Don’t be silly! EDMUNDIt’s over, Rose. The investors bailed, the bank’s calling in debts... I’ve got nothing left! ROSE (EXTENDS A TREMBLING HAND)You still have me! We’ll figure something out, please—just come down, okay? Edmund stares at her, hopeless. EDMUNDThere’s no way out... nobody can help me. Rose runs to the corner, grabs her phone, and dials frantically. Edmund lets out a bitter laugh. He steps forward, toes over the edge—then freezes as he looks down. He pulls back, trembling. EDMUND (VOICE SHAKING) (CONT'D)It’s so high... I—I don’t wanna die.
1.2 INT. STAIRWELL – DAY2 2

Rose holds her phone to her ear. LOCKE (V.O.)Rose, three years, and this is the first time you’ve called me. ROSEI’m sorry, Locke. Please do me a favor, just this once. Use my trust fund, under Blackstone Capital’s name, to invest 200 million in Edmund’s company! LOCKE (V.O.)(BEAT)Are you insane? That company’s collapsing. He isn’t worth it. ROSE (VOICE TREMBLING BUT FIRM)Please, Uncle! He’s on the rooftop right now—I can’t watch him die! And... I’m pregnant with his baby.
LOCKE (V.O.)(SIGHS)Fine. But only once. Rose exhales, relieved.
1.3 EXT. ROOFTOP – DAY3 3

VIVIAN leans back against the rooftop railing, flicks open a lighter and lights a cigarette. Hearing the sound, Edmund turns around, surprised. EDMUNDVivian? What are you doing here? VIVIANBlackstone Capital just invested two hundred million in your company. Come down. EDMUND (EXCITED)Blackstone Capital? (confused) Why would they help me? Vivian lets out a soft laugh, turns away with a mysterious air. When she’s far enough, she glances back, winks at him. VIVIANWhat do you think? Edmund freezes. He hurries after her. EDMUNDWas it you?
1.4 INT. STAIRWELL – DAY4 4
Rose ends the call, leans against the wall, exhausted. ROSE (V.O.)Maybe it’s time to tell him that I’m the heiress of Blackstone Capital. She looks toward the sunlight above and runs upstairs.
1.5 EXT. ROOFTOP – DAY5 5
Edmund rushes after Vivian, only to run into Rose returning. Rose looks shy and a little nervous. ROSEEdmund, I want to tell you- Edmund pulls her into a quick, distracted hug.

EDMUNDBabe, I’ve got something important. Talk to you later, okay? ROSEBut— Edmund kisses her cheek. EDMUNDWait for me at home tonight, alright? He brushes past her, chasing after Vivian. Rose watches him go, thoughtful. ROSE (V.O.)I’ve hidden my identity for so long. He might be angry about it. Tonight I’ll tell him everything, and the baby. A faint, hopeful smile appears on her face.
2.1 EXT. COUNTRYSIDE - DAY6 6

Bodies lie scattered across the ground. Locke’s white shirt is streaked with blood, slashed open in places. His hand is wrapped in a bloody bandage as he ends a call. He looks down at the name “Rose” on his phone screen and exhales.
2.2 INT. WINSTON MANOR - BATHROOM - NIGHT7 7

Steam fills the room. Locke showers, his muscular back and old scars visible under the running water. Suddenly, the door bursts open — Rose stumbles in, clearly drunk. Locke startles, grabbing a towel and wrapping it around his waist. LOCKERose? Rose throws her arms around his neck, eyes red. ROSELocke, I love you! LOCKE (SHOCKED)Do you understand what you’re saying?
He tries to pry her hands off, but she clings to him.

ROSEI’m not a kid anymore. I know what I feel! I love you, like a woman loves a man! LOCKE (UNSTEADY)I’m your uncle, Rose! Do you understand? There can’t be love between us! He forces her off him, putting space between them. ROSEWhy not? We’re not blood-related! LOCKEYour grandfather entrusted you to me so I could protect you — not to have feelings for you! Rose stands frozen, her expression shattered.
2.3 EXT. COUNTRYSIDE - DAY8 8

LOCKEI can't accept your love... I promised your grandfather I’d take care of you. He takes a hard drink, eyes turning cold. LOCKE (CONT'D)But if Edmund betrays you, I’ll make him pay! Locke grabs his phone again. LOCKE (CONT'D)Prepare the jet. I’m going back.
2.4 INT. BAR – NIGHT9 9

Edmund sits on a lounge sofa, looking at Vivian, thrilled. EDMUNDThe Blackstone Capital actually invested my comopany! Vivian, wait—are you... The heiress of Blackstone Capital? Vivian hesitates, then decides to play along. VIVIAN (AMUSED)Didn’t expect you to figure it out. That's impressive.
VIVIAN (V.O.)My father’s news comes at just a right time. It’s useful to be Locke’s aide.
2.5 INT. EDMUND’S VILLA - DINING ROOM – NIGHT10 10

Rose works in the dining room, preparing dinner. She hides a ring inside a cake, smiling as she sets it on the table. ROSE (V.O.)He’s been dreaming about us getting married. I’m sure he will say yes. (touching her belly) I just hope... he won’t be mad that I have been hiding who I am—for the baby’s sake.
2.6 INT. BAR – NIGHT11 11

EDMUNDVivian, why would you help me? You— Vivian places a finger on his lips, teasingly. VIVIAN (FLIRTATIOUS)Don’t you already know what I want? EDMUNDWhatever it is... I’ll give it to you. Vivian strokes his cheek slowly. VIVIANI heard you’re getting a little too close to the girl at the company — Rose, right? Your girlfriend? EDMUNDRose? She’s nothing. Just a way to… blow off steam. You’re the only one I love. VIVIANThen prove it. I want you to propose to me — publicly. I want a grand engagement that the whole world can see. Edmund’s surprised, then light up with excitement. EDMUNDI'll give you that. I promise.
VIVIAN (V.O.)Once you marry me, it won’t matter if I’m really the heiress or not. I’ll still become one of the elite...
2.7 INT. EDMUND’S VILLA – KITCHEN – NIGHT12 12

Rose glances at the clock. 7:50 P.M. ROSE (V.O.)It’s almost eight. He should be home by now. She lights the candles and arranges the roses neatly on the table. Then she picks up her phone and calls Edmund.
2.8 INT. HOTEL ROOM – NIGHT13 13

Edmund and Vivian are tangled together in bed. Suddenly, Edmund’s phone starts ringing. He reaches for it, but Vivian presses her hand on his chest, stopping him. VIVIANYou said she's nothing! EDMUNDOf course. She’s nothing compared to you. You’re the heiress of Blackstone Capital. The only woman I’ll ever love is you. Vivian smiles in satisfaction. Edmund grabs his phone, ends the call, and leans in to kiss her again.
2.9 INT. EDMUND’S VILLA - DINING ROOM – NIGHT14 14

Rose stares at her phone, confused. ROSE (V.O.)Did something happen? Suddenly, she doubles over in pain, clutching her belly. ROSEAh... She strokes her belly gently, trying to calm herself. ROSE (CONT'D)Don't worry, baby. Daddy's very excited to meet you—he’ll be home soon, I promise.
3.2 INT. EDMUND’S VILLA - FRONT DOOR - NIGHT 16 16

ROSEEdmund! You’re back! The door opens. Standing there—Locke. Rose freezes, her smile fading. ROSE (CONT'D)Locke? What are you doing here? Locke’s expression darkens. He grabs her wrist. LOCKE (FURIOUS)Come with me! ROSE (STRUGGLING)Let go of me! What are you doing? I’m not leaving! Edmund’s coming back—I’m gonna propose to him! Let me go! Rose yanks her arm free, stepping back defensively. Locke slams his fist into the wall in anger.
LOCKE (SEETHING)Propose? Do you even know who he spent the night with? He’s proposing to someone else! Rose stares at him, stunned. ROSEWhat? Locke softens, pulls out his phone, shows her a video.
3.3 INT. PHONE SCREEN - NEWS FOOTAGE - NIGHT17 17
NEWS ANCHORBreaking news! Young entrepreneur Edmund Reed just proposed to Miss Vivian in a lavish ceremony today!
3.3 EXT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - FRONT DOOR – DAY21 21

A sleek black car pulls up outside. Locke is about to open the door. Rose stops him with a hand. ROSELet me go. Please, just wait here for me. LOCKE (FIRM)No way. I’m not gonna let you face that bastard alone. ROSE (STEADY)I can’t live under your protection forever. Let me handle this, please. LOCKE (SIGHS)You always have a reaoson, don’t you? (softer, touching her head) Just remember—no matter what, I’ll always protect you. Rose nods, opens the door, and steps out.
3.4 INT. PHONE SCREEN - PRESS CONFERENCE - NIGHT18 18
Edmund grins at reporters, holding up a ring.
EDMUNDI picked this diamond ring especially for Miss Vivian... I just hope she’ll say yes.
3.5 INT. EDMUND’S VILLA - FRONT DOOR - NIGHT19 19

Rose stares at the phone, devastated. ROSENo... this can’t be real... LOCKE (BITTER)That’s the man you chose. You gave him your trust, your money, your child—and he’s proposing to someone else. ROSE (SHAKING HER HEAD)He promised me... he said once we have a child, he’d marry me. Locke sighs, gently wiping her tears. LOCKE (SOFTLY)Don’t cry. He’s not worth it. I’ll take you home. Rose’s eyes harden. She shakes her head. ROSE (COLDLY)No. I’m going to that restaurant. LOCKE (ANGRY)You’re going to humiliate yourself for him? ROSE (DETERMINED)There are things I need to hear from him... with my own ears. Take me there, please. Locke lets out a low, bitter laugh. LOCKENo way. ROSEThen I’ll go myself. She turns to leave. LOCKEWait! He grabs her hand. She turns back. Locke exhales.
LOCKE (RESIGNED) (CONT'D)So stubborn... fine, I’ll take you.
3.6 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY20 20

A grand staircase is covered in red carpet. Roses line the railings. Guests gather below, clapping and whispering. At the top stand Edmund and Vivian. EDMUNDVivian, thank you for convincing Mr. Harris to invest my company. VIVIAN (SMILING)Locke’s always adored me. Getting the funds? Easy-peasy. Edmund takes her hand, kissing it tenderly. EDMUNDThank you, my love. You’re the heiress of Blackstone Capital, yet you're still willing to help me... I’m truly moved.
The clock strikes seven. Rose jerks awake at the dining table—candles burned down to stubs. Suddenly, the doorbell rings sharply. She leaps up, joy flooding her face. She rushes to the door, smiling.
4.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY22 22
Edmund half kneels, holding out a ring.

EDMUNDVivian, will you marry me? Vivian gasps, covering her mouth, extending her hand. VIVIAN (SMILES)Of course I will! ROSE (O.S.)Wait! The doors burst open. All eyes turn toward the entrance. Edmund, Vivian freeze in shock. Rose stands there, sweat dampening the strands of hair stuck to her cheeks. Her gaze cuts through the crowd, locking straight on Edmund. Edmund rises slowly, his face dark. EDMUND (ANNOYED)Rose? What the hell are you doing here? Rose steps toward the stairs, her face calm but filled with despair. ROSEEdmund, I've been waiting for you all night! Vivian frowns, tugging at Edmund’s sleeve. VIVIANIs your sex mate making a scene? Rose freezes, staring at them in disbelief. EDMUND (COLDLY)Just ignore her. Vivian chuckles, mocking. She puts her arm around Edmund's. Rose lets out a sharp laugh, disbelief flashing across her tear-streaked face. ROSESex mate? Then what about your promise to marry me? EDMUND (SHRUGS)It's just pillow talk. You didn’t actually believe it, did you? Laughter ripples through the guests. Vivian hides a smirk behind her hand, pretending to pity Rose. VIVIANEdmund marry you? Please. Look at yourself—those cheap clothes, that pathetic look. You’re a bargain-bin girl at best. She pinches her nose, stepping back dramatically.

EDMUNDRose, you’re nothing! Don’t you dare compare yourself to Vivian; she’s Miss Winston, the only heiress of Blackstone Capital! Rose freezes. Her thoughts race. ROSE (V.O.)So... she impersonated me? Edmund pulls a checkbook from his pocket, scribbles. EDMUNDHere. Fifty thousand. You’ve done your job these past three years. Consider it a tip—now take it and get out! Vivian laughs, face full of disdain. Rose wipes away her tears, snatches the check, and tears it into pieces in front of them. Edmund and Vivian stare, stunned. ROSEI gave you 200 million without blinking. You think I care about your lousy fifty grand? She throws the shredded pieces in their faces. ROSE (RAISING HER VOICE) (CONT'D)Oh, and since we’re all here—allow me to introduce myself. (pauses, eyes scanning the crowd) I am the real Miss Winston! Gasps echo through the room. Everyone stares in shock.
5.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY23 23

EDMUND (MOCKING)Cut the crap, Rose. You think you’re Miss Winston? That's hilarious. If you’re the heiress, then I’m the next president—no, hell, I’m Louis the Sixteenth! I’ll chop my own head off and make you a footstool! Hahaha! The crowd bursts into laughter. VIVIAN (SCOFFING)A subway-riding slum whore calling herself an heiress? What a joke. ROSE (COLDLY)I’m not wasting my breath on a lying thief like you.

Vivian, furious, slaps Rose hard across the face. VIVIAN (SHOUTING)You bitch! How dare you talk back to me?! Rose freezes for a second, then rolls up her sleeve and slaps Vivian right back. VIVIAN (SCREAMING) (CONT'D)Ah! You slut! I’ll kill you! Edmund! How come you just stand there and watch her slaping my face? Edmund rushes over, glaring at Rose. EDMUND (ANGRILY)Rose! How dare you be so rude to Miss Winston! Apologize to her right now, that’s an order! ROSEGet out of my way! Edmund grabs her wrist, leaning close, voice low. EDMUND (SMIRKING)If you apologize, we can still keep... what we had. I could let you stay on—as my mistress. Rose looks at him, shocked. Edmund mistakes her silence for hesitation, his grin widening. EDMUND (WHISPERING) (CONT'D)Just keep quiet about it. She never has to know. He squeezes her wrist suggestively, eyes gleaming. Rose jerks her arm free and slaps him across the face—hard. ROSE (COLDLY)Edmund, you're such an idiot. You can’t even tell who the real Miss Winston is. I’ll make sure Blackstone Capital pulls every cent out of your company. Edmund stiffens, uneasy. Vivian clenches her fists. VIVIAN (TENSE)You’re not gonna believe this slut’s lie, are you? Edmund glances between them. EDMUND (V.O.)Who's the real Miss Winston? I need to find out. He gently takes Vivian’s hand.

EDMUNDVivian, I’m not doubting you. But our engagement is of utmost importance, we should invite Mr. Harris. Can you give him a call? VIVIAN (V.O.)Damn it... he’s suspicious. Stupid corporate bastard! VIVIANLocke never shows his face in public. You really think you can meet him as will? EDMUNDThen you’d better prove it, right? VIVIANLocke’s chief aide, Tom, handles all his affairs. If I can get Tom to vouch for me, would that be enough? Edmund frowns, thinking, then nods. EDMUNDOf course. Tom speaks for Mr. Harris — we all know that. Other guests murmur in agreement. GUESTThat’s true. No one’s seen Mr. Harris for years. It’s always his assistant Tom speaking on his behalf. Vivian dials her phone, putting it on speaker. The screen shows a contact: “TOM.” VIVIAN (V.O.)Good thing Tom is my dad ... hope he doesn’t screw this up. VIVIANTom. ROSE (V.O.)She really have Tom’s number?
5.2 INT. BLACKSTONE CAPITAL – SECRETARIAL OFFICE – DAY24 24
TOM (CHUCKLING)My dear little princess, what’s the matter?
5.3 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY25 25
EDMUND (V.O., EXCITED)That settles it! Vivian really is Miss Winston—Locke’s assistant just called her “princess”!
6.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY26 26

Edmund hurries over to Vivian, eager to please. EDMUNDAre you really Mr. Harris's chief assistant? I’ve heard so much about you— VIVIAN (INTERRUPTING)Edmund, Tom and I have business to discuss. I’ll introduce you to Mr. Harris later. For now, could you wait here? Edmund freezes, then nods. Vivian moves toward the window. She turns off speaker mode and lowers her voice. VIVIAN (CONT'D)Where’s Mr. Harris right now? TOM (ON PHONE)Why are you asking about Mr. Harris again? Trying to impersonate the heiress now? VIVIANPlease, Dad, I’m desperate. I don’t have any other way. TOM (SIGHING)Mr. Harris is in Deer Town. He won’t be back for at least three months. As for the heiress—she vanished three years ago. VIVIAN (EXCITED)Perfect! Dad, I need you to back me up on this — just once. TOMThis is the last time. Vivian exhales in relief, runs back to the center of the crowd, and switches her phone to speaker mode. TOM (ON SPEAKER) (CONT'D)Vivian is indeed the heiress of Blackstone Capital. She insisted on traveling alone, so please take good care of her. Blackstone will show our gratitude.

The crowd exchanges excited glances. EDMUNDOf course. We’ll take good care of the young lady. Please tell Mr. Harris not to worry. VIVIANAlright, Tom. You can go now. TOMYes, Miss. Vivian ends the call and turns to the crowd. VIVIANWell? Does anyone still doubt my identity? EDMUND (FORCED SMILE)Of course not. I always believe you, darling. Vivian lets out a cold snort and fixes her eyes on Rose. VIVIAN (SMIRKING)And you? You pathetic impostor — what else do you have to say? ROSE (CALM)How ridiculous. You and Tom seem a little too familiar, maybe there’s something going on between you two? Vivian's stunned. EDMUND (SNAPPING)Enough, Rose! Stop embarrassing yourself. You were pretending to be Miss Winston, trying to force me into marriage— stop dreaming. You liar! ROSE (LOUDLY)No, I came to tell you... I’m pregnant with your child. EDMUND (STUNNED)What? Rose pulls a pregnancy test and throws it in his face. Edmund and Vivian stare, speechless.
7.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT – PARTY HALL - DAY27 27
Edmund stares at the pregnancy test in disbelief.

EDMUND (CANT HIDE HIS JOY)You’re pregnant... I’m going to be a father... VIVIAN (PANICKED, V.O.)That bitch is pregnant with Edmund’s child... Vivian's furious and hooks her arm through Edmund’s. VIVIAN (COLD) (CONT'D)Edmund, don’t forget, I saved your company. Edmund snaps back to reality and turns to Vivian. EDMUND (DEFIANT)Of course I remember. VIVIAN (MEAN)Then choose. Me—or her and that mystery bastard she’s carrying. Rose laughs softly. ROSE (SCORNING)Choose? Edmund, remember — I was the one who dumped your ass. You don’t deserve me. And the baby is mine alone. You have nothing to do with it. Edmund’s face flushes red. EDMUNDYou— ROSE (TO VIVIAN, ICY)Go on, cuddle your corporate trash. No one’s stealing this from you. Vivian clamps down on her anger, then turns to Edmund with a smile that’s all poison. VIVIAN (SWEET BUT VICIOUS)Edmund, I don’t care how you feel—she can’t have that baby. If she keeps it, there’s no future for us. Do it now. Rose freezes, horrified. She looks at Edmund, his expression dark. ROSE (SCARED)Edmund, what are you thinking... This is the child you wanted—don’t you remember? Edmund’s eyes drop to Rose’s belly, torn.
7.2 INT. EDMUND’S VILLA — NURSERY – DAY28 28

Edmund and Rose arrange the nursery together. ROSEWe’re not even married and you’re already setting up a nursery—why rush? Edmund places a stroller in the room, sits on the floor, gentle and earnest. EDMUND (TENDER)Rose, my family line has to continue. My parents want grandchildren. I’ve never found the right woman—until you. Rose is moved. Edmund pulls her close. EDMUND (CONT'D)I want to have kids with you—one boy, one girl. Siblings. Then we’ll get married.
7.3 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY29 29
Vivian nudges Edmund. VIVIAN (SNEERING)What’s that look? You gonna keep this baby? Edmund snaps back to focus on Rose’s belly.

Vivian slaps Edmund across the face. VIVIAN (FURIOUS)If you don't get rid of the child, you get nothing—don’t forget, that two hundred million comes from me! Edmund’s fists clench. The last of his hesitation hardens into cold resolve. EDMUND (GRITTING HIS TEETH)I will only have kids with you, Vivian. And this bitch... we will hear about her miscarriage tomorrow morning. Rose recoils, stunned and horrified.
ROSE (DESPERATE)Edmund—no matter what happens between us, that child is yours. It’s your blood! Edmund walks toward her. Rose stumbles, tries to run.
7.4 EXT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - FRONT DOOR – NIGHT30 30
A black luxury car idles curbside. Locke smokes, watching the restaurant.
7.5 INT. MANSION BEDROOM – NIGHT31 31

Rose’s grandfather, gravely ill, clutches her small hand. He places it into Locke’s. GRANDFATHER (WEAK)Locke, you’re the one I trust most. I’m leaving Rose to you. Keep her safe. Locke nods solemnly, gripping Rose’s hand like a promise. Little Rose looks up, trusting.
7.6 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - DAY32 32
Rose starts down the stairs but Edmund grabs her arm. EDMUNDDon’t run! ROSE (FRIGHTENED)That’s your child, Edmund! Are you really going to kill your own baby just to protect a lie?
7.7 EXT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - FRONT DOOR – NIGHT33 33
Locke looks back at the restaurant, resolve hardening. LOCKE (V.O.)I swore I’d keep Rose safe—no one will hurt her. Even if it costs me my life.
8.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY34 34

EDMUND (CRUELLY)Don’t twist things. You’re nothing but a cheap slut—who knows whose kid that is? Rose stares at him, shocked. ROSE (HURT)What did you just say? You know you’re the only man I’ve ever been with! You’ll do anything to climb higher, won’t you? Edmund smirks coldly. EDMUNDIf you love me so much, then do me one last favor. Once that baby’s gone, I’ll finally be one of the elite. Rose slaps him hard. ROSE (FURIOUS)You idiot! I’m the real Blackstone heiress! You’ll regret this—Blackstone Capital won’t let you off! Edmund rubs his cheek, sneering. EDMUND (DISGUSTED)Still pretending? You could never compare to the real heiress—stop humiliating yourself. Vivian descends the staircase in her heels, standing beside Edmund, gazing down at Rose with contempt. Her eyes flick toward the long staircase behind Rose—then back to Edmund, a sinister smile forming. VIVIAN (COLDLY)Edmund, do it. Don’t let her ruin our engagement. I’m still waiting for you to put that ring on my finger. ROSE (DEFYING)If you dare touch me, Edmund, I swear I’ll make your life a living hell. Rose fumbles through her purse, pulling out her phone to call Locke. Edmund’s eyes harden—pain replaced by resolve. He suddenly shoves her with all his strength.

Rose’s eyes widen. She screams as she tumbles backward down the stairs, phone flying and shattering. ROSE (SCREAMING)Ah—no! My baby! Her body bounces down the steps. Fragments of memory flash through her mind— — Rose holding a pregnancy test, smiling. — Rose pacing the nursery, touching her belly. — Rose’s voice, soft and hopeful. ROSE (V.O.)Baby, don’t worry. We’ll wait for Daddy together. He’ll be so happy when he knows you exist... The montage fades. Rose lies at the foot of the stairs. Blood spreads beneath her. Guests gasp. Rose curls up in pain, tears and blood mingling down her face. Above, Vivian and Edmund stand on the stairs, cold and victorious. VIVIAN (CRUELLY)Rose, this is for your own good. Your child would’ve been born in some filthy clinic, grown up a servant like you. I did you a favor, and you should be grateful I ended your suffering. Rose clutches her abdomen ， whispering weakly. Her eyes flutter. A single tear slides down her cheek. ROSEMy... baby... I’m sorry... I couldn’t protect you...
8.2 EXT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - FRONT DOOR – DAY35 35

Locke sits in his car, smoking anxiously. A waiter rushes out of the restaurant, panicked. WAITER (URGENT)Mr. Harris, Miss Winston's in trouble! Locke’s eyes widen. He throws open the car door and runs toward the entrance. LOCKE (ALARMED)Rose! From the cars behind, several men in black suits get out and follow. Leading them is a tall, grim man—ERIC, Locke’s head of security.
9.1 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY36 36

Vivian lifts a glass of red wine from the champagne tower, standing proudly at the top of the stairs. VIVIAN (SMIRKING)Rose, do you like the ending I prepared for you? Fits your kind perfectly. She picks up another glass and hands it to Edmund. He takes it silently and downs it in one go. VIVIAN (SATISFIED) (CONT'D)Nice work. Rose lies in a pool of blood, struggling to open her eyes. Through the blur she sees them toasting, her fingers twitching as she whispers for help. ROSE (WEAK)Help... please... call 911... Bystanders exchange uneasy looks but hesitate to move— only one woman, LUCY, rushes forward. LUCY (FRANTIC)Don’t worry, I’m calling right now! Rose relaxes. Lucy dials 911; the phone starts ringing. Vivian scoffs, walking down the stairs with her wine glass. Edmund follows. Vivian kneels beside Rose and pours the wine over her face. Rose twists away in pain.

Lucy grabs Vivian’s wrist. LUCY (ANGRY)What the hell are you doing?! Stop it! VIVIAN (CHILLINGLY)You going to stand against me? LUCY (SHAKING, DEFIANT)You can’t just assault someone in public! That’s a crime! VIVIAN (SMIRKING)Do you even know who I am? I’m the sole heiress of Blackstone Capital.
The emergency line connects.

NURSE (V.O.)Hello, this is emergency services- Vivian leans close, voice dripping with threat. VIVIAN (LOW)Say a word, and I’ll make sure you and your family never see another sunrise. Rose groans. Lucy looks between them, trembling. LUCY (QUIETLY, INTO PHONE)Sorry... wrong number. Rose shakes her head weakly, hope draining from her eyes. Lucy hangs up, guilt brimming. Vivian smirks. VIVIAN (COLDLY)Game’s not over yet. Edmund—hit her. I want her to never carry a child again. Edmund’s eyes darken. He rolls up his sleeves and steps forward. Rose starts crawling toward the exit, leaving a trail of blood. Edmund stomps down on her leg. EDMUND (SNARLING)Think you can run? ROSE (TERRIFIED)Please... don’t...
9.2 EXT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - FRONT DOOR – DAY37 37
Locke and his security team sprint toward the building.
9.3 INT. MICHELIN RESTAURANT - PARTY HALL – DAY38 38
Edmund kicks Rose in the stomach.
EDMUND (TO HIS MEN)All of you! Do it! Crush her belly!

A wave of bodyguards rushes forward, kicking and punching mercilessly. Rose curls up, screaming. ROSE (V.O.)Baby... I’m sorry... this world... it’s so cruel... As the blows rain down, she hears— a baby’s laugh, soft and clear. Her eyes widen. Through the blur, she “sees” a barefoot baby crawling toward her, smiling.

She reaches out, whispering. But Edmund’s boot slams into her again. The vision shatters. Only cold marble remains. Rose sobs. ROSE (FEEBLE)Baby... My baby... Lucy can’t stand it any longer—she steps in again. LUCY (PLEADING)Stop! You can’t just kill her—no matter who you are! Edmund hesitates. Vivian sneers, grabs a candle holder, shoves it into Edmund’s hand. VIVIAN (ICILY)End it. Give her a clean death. Edmund swallows hard, lifts the candle holder. EDMUND (QUIETLY)I’m sorry...
